info.title: Heavy Duty API
info.description: HTTP API of the Heavy Duty training app.

token.description: Token from the enrollment link fragment

error.example: offsite copy failed: repository does not exist

get.summary: Report the API and database status

200.description: The API is running and the database answers

503.description: The API is running but the database does not answer

post.summary: Start the enrollment of a passkey with the token of an enrollment link

200.description: Options for navigator.credentials.create()

400.description: enrollment_token_invalid: the enrollment link expired, was used or does not exist

403.description: The Origin header belongs to another site

post.summary: Finish the enrollment, spend the enrollment link and open an access session

201.description: The passkey was stored and the hd_session cookie was set

400.description: enrollment_token_invalid or enrollment_failed

403.description: The Origin header belongs to another site

post.summary: Start a sign-in with a discoverable passkey

200.description: Options for navigator.credentials.get()

403.description: The Origin header belongs to another site

post.summary: Finish the sign-in and open an access session

200.description: The passkey was verified and the hd_session cookie was set

400.description: invalid_request: the body is not a JSON object

401.description: sign_in_failed: the passkey is unknown or the verification failed

403.description: The Origin header belongs to another site

get.summary: Report whether the access session cookie is valid

200.description: The access session is valid

delete.summary: Sign out: end the access session and clear its cookie

204.description: The access session ended and the cookie was cleared

403.description: The Origin header belongs to another site

get.summary: Describe /mcp as an OAuth protected resource

200.description: Protected resource metadata of /mcp (RFC 9728)

get.summary: Describe /mcp as an OAuth protected resource, for clients that try the root first

200.description: Protected resource metadata of /mcp (RFC 9728)

get.summary: Describe the authorization server of the app (RFC 8414)

200.description: Authorization server metadata

post.summary: Register a public OAuth client of the MCP (RFC 7591)

201.description: The client was registered; it reaches nothing until the PO approves it

400.description: invalid_redirect_uri or invalid_client_metadata

413.description: invalid_request: the body is larger than 16 KiB

get.summary: Check an authorization request and describe it for the consent screen

200.description: consent with the declared client name and the redirect host, or error_redirect with the address that carries the OAuth error

400.description: oauth_client_unknown or oauth_redirect_uri_invalid: nothing may redirect

post.summary: Approve or deny an authorization request of an MCP client

200.description: Address of the redirect_uri with code and state on approval, or with error=access_denied on denial

400.description: invalid_request, oauth_client_unknown or oauth_redirect_uri_invalid: nothing may redirect

403.description: The Origin header belongs to another site

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code or a refresh token for an MCP credential

200.description: A credential of 1 hour and a new refresh token; Cache-Control: no-store

400.description: invalid_request, invalid_grant, invalid_target or unsupported_grant_type

413.description: invalid_request: the body is larger than 16 KiB

get.summary: List the muscle groups in catalog order

200.description: The muscle groups ordered by position

get.summary: List the registered muscles with their muscle group

200.description: The muscles ordered by slug

post.summary: Register a muscle in a muscle group

400.description: Missing muscle group (muscle_group_required) or missing name (muscle_name_required)

409.description: A muscle with the same name already exists (muscle_already_exists)

422.description: The muscle group is not in the catalog (muscle_group_not_found)

get.summary: List the active exercises with their muscles and muscle groups

200.description: The active exercises ordered by slug

post.summary: Register a reps or time exercise with the muscles it works

400.description: Missing name (exercise_name_required), missing kind (exercise_kind_required), kind other than reps or time (exercise_kind_invalid), no primary muscle (exercise_muscle_required) or a muscle given twice (exercise_muscle_duplicated)

409.description: An exercise with the same name already exists (exercise_already_exists)

422.description: A muscle is not in the catalog (muscle_not_found)

post.summary: Create a program with a name and a goal; it becomes the only active program

201.description: The created program, active and without days

400.description: Missing or blank name (program_name_required), missing goal (program_goal_required) or goal other than strength, hypertrophy or endurance (program_goal_invalid)

get.summary: List the programs, the active one first and the others from newest to oldest

200.description: The programs with their days and planned exercises

get.summary: Show a program with its days and planned exercises in plan order

200.description: The program

patch.summary: Change the name or the goal of a program; only the fields sent change

200.description: The changed program

400.description: Null, empty or blank name (program_name_required), null or empty goal (program_goal_required) or goal other than strength, hypertrophy or endurance (program_goal_invalid)

post.summary: Add a day (letter A to Z, optional label) at the end of the program plan

201.description: The program with the new day last

400.description: Missing letter (program_day_letter_required) or letter other than A to Z (program_day_letter_invalid)

409.description: The letter already exists in the program (program_day_letter_duplicated)

post.summary: Add a catalog exercise with sets, target, load in grams and rest in seconds to a day

201.description: The program with the new planned exercise last in the day

400.description: Invalid letter (program_day_letter_invalid), missing exercise (planned_exercise_exercise_required), sets not an integer from 1 (planned_exercise_sets_invalid), missing or invalid load (planned_exercise_load_required, planned_exercise_load_invalid), missing or invalid rest (planned_exercise_rest_required, planned_exercise_rest_invalid), reps on a time exercise (planned_exercise_target_time), seconds on a reps exercise (planned_exercise_target_reps), missing target (planned_exercise_target_required) or target not an integer from 1 (planned_exercise_target_invalid)

404.description: No program with this id (program_not_found) or no such letter in the program (program_day_not_found)

409.description: The exercise is already in this day (planned_exercise_duplicated)

422.description: The exercise is not in the catalog or is archived (exercise_not_found)

post.summary: Make a program the only active one; the previous active program stays stored but inactive

200.description: The program, now active

patch.summary: Change the label of a day; null, empty or blank clears it and the letter stays

200.description: The program with the changed day

400.description: Letter other than A to Z (program_day_letter_invalid)

404.description: No program with this id (program_not_found) or no such letter in the program (program_day_not_found)

delete.summary: Remove a day with its planned exercises; the other days keep their order and recorded workouts keep their letter and sets

200.description: The program without the day

400.description: Letter other than A to Z (program_day_letter_invalid)

404.description: No program with this id (program_not_found) or no such letter in the program (program_day_not_found)

patch.summary: Change sets, target, load in grams or rest in seconds of a planned exercise; only the fields sent change and recorded workouts keep their values

200.description: The program with the changed planned exercise

400.description: Invalid letter (program_day_letter_invalid), sets not an integer from 1 (planned_exercise_sets_invalid), load not an integer from 0 (planned_exercise_load_invalid), rest not an integer from 0 (planned_exercise_rest_invalid), reps on a time exercise (planned_exercise_target_time), seconds on a reps exercise (planned_exercise_target_reps) or target not an integer from 1 (planned_exercise_target_invalid); null counts as invalid

404.description: No program with this id (program_not_found), no such letter in the program (program_day_not_found) or the exercise is not in the day (planned_exercise_not_found)

delete.summary: Remove a planned exercise from a day; the other exercises keep their order and recorded workouts keep their sets

200.description: The program without the planned exercise

400.description: Letter other than A to Z (program_day_letter_invalid)

404.description: No program with this id (program_not_found), no such letter in the program (program_day_not_found) or the exercise is not in the day (planned_exercise_not_found)

get.summary: Report the backup status: latest run, last successful run and recent runs

200.description: The backup status, with null runs when no backup ran yet

get.summary: Show the active program days in plan order, the suggested letter and each planned exercise with its prefilled load

200.description: The workout of the day, with a null program and no days when no program is active

post.summary: Record a set with the id generated on the phone; the first set of a workout creates the workout. Sending the same id with the same values again records nothing new

200.description: A set with this id already exists with the same values; the stored set

201.description: The recorded set; the workout was created if it did not exist

400.description: Body outside the schema (invalid_request), letter other than A to Z (program_day_letter_invalid), negative load (workout_set_load_invalid), reps below 1 (workout_set_reps_invalid), seconds below 1 (workout_set_seconds_invalid), no measure, both measures or the measure of the other kind (workout_set_measure_invalid), set number below 1 (workout_set_number_invalid) or exercise other than the one of the planned exercise (workout_set_exercise_mismatch)

403.description: Origin other than the app origin (forbidden_origin)

409.description: The workout id exists with another program, letter or start (workout_conflict), the set id exists with other values or in another workout (workout_set_id_conflict) or the workout already has this set number for the exercise (workout_set_duplicated)

422.description: No such program (program_not_found), no such letter in the program (program_day_not_found) or no such planned exercise in the letter (planned_exercise_not_found)

patch.summary: Replace the load and the measure of a recorded set, also after the workout ended. Sending the same values again changes nothing

200.description: The set with the values now stored

400.description: Body or ids outside the schema (invalid_request), negative load (workout_set_load_invalid), reps below 1 (workout_set_reps_invalid), seconds below 1 (workout_set_seconds_invalid) or no measure, both measures or the measure of the other kind (workout_set_measure_invalid)

403.description: Origin other than the app origin (forbidden_origin)

404.description: No such workout (workout_not_found) or no such set in the workout (workout_set_not_found)

post.summary: Record how and when a workout ended. Sending the same instant and reason again changes nothing

200.description: The workout with its end, recorded now or by an earlier identical request

400.description: Body outside the schema (invalid_request), reason other than completed or ended_early (workout_end_reason_invalid), instant that is not UTC ISO 8601 (workout_finished_at_invalid) or instant before the start (workout_finished_before_start)

403.description: Origin other than the app origin (forbidden_origin)

409.description: The workout already ended with another instant or reason (workout_already_finished)

post.summary: Record an exercise left out of a workout. Sending the same skip again changes nothing

200.description: The skip recorded by an earlier identical request

400.description: Body outside the schema (invalid_request), instant that is not UTC ISO 8601 (workout_skipped_at_invalid) or instant before the start (workout_skipped_before_start)

403.description: Origin other than the app origin (forbidden_origin)

409.description: The exercise was already skipped in this workout at another instant or by another planned exercise (workout_skip_conflict)

422.description: Planned exercise missing or outside the letter of the workout (planned_exercise_not_found)

get.summary: List the workouts that started in a UTC interval, from inclusive to exclusive, oldest first, with sets and the exercises left out

200.description: The workouts of the interval, an empty list when none started in it

400.description: Missing or malformed from or to (workout_range_required), to not after from (workout_range_inverted) or interval above 92 days (workout_range_too_long)

delete.summary: Remove a workout with its sets and the exercises left out. The phone confirms before the call, so the route takes no confirmation code

400.description: Id that is not a UUID (invalid_request)

403.description: Origin other than the app origin (forbidden_origin)

get.summary: Get the state of the activity window of each muscle group now: resting, open, cooling or none

200.description: The 11 muscle groups in catalog order, each with its state and the instants of its last training and window, null when the group was never trained
